script.title: SENDING BACK SUSHI
script.story_hook: One bite tells you something is wrong.
script.intro_zh: 一口就知道餐點不對勁
script.welcome_en: Welcome back to our little table. Tonight we eat out, and speak up.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎回到我們的小餐桌。今晚外出用餐，也要敢開口。
script.outro: See? Polite words fix bad meals. Listen again, and try it out loud.
script.outro_zh: 看見了吧？溫和的幾句話就能換來新餐點。再聽一遍，大膽跟著說。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一句一句跟著唸。
script.char_a_description: An elegant older woman with silver hair in a loose bun, pearl earrings, a deep blue silk blouse, and thin gold glasses, sitting upright with a calm polite manner.
script.char_b_description: A young man with short dark hair and a friendly worried face, wearing a black waiter vest over a white shirt, a navy apron tied at his waist, and clean black shoes.
script.thumbnail_action: holding chopsticks over a cold sushi roll

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, sorry to bother you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuːz mi ˈsɑɹi tə ˈbɑtʃər ju/
dialogue.zh: 打擾一下，不好意思麻煩你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No trouble at all. Is everything okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈtrʌbəl ət ˈɔl ɪz ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ ˌoʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 一點麻煩也沒有。一切都好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, it's this shrimp tempura roll.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ɪts ðɪs ʃɹɪmp tɛmˈpʊɹə ˈɹoʊl/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，就是這盤蝦子天婦羅卷。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What seems to be the problem?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ˈsimz tə bi ðə ˈpɹɑbləm/
dialogue.zh: 請問問題是什麼呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The roll is cold inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈɹoʊl ɪz koʊd ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 捲餅中間是冷的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cold? Do you mean the rice, or shrimp?
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊd du ju min ðə ˈɹaɪs ɔr ʃɹɪmp/
dialogue.zh: 冷的？您是指米飯還是蝦子？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shrimp, mainly. It looks underdone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃɹɪmp ˈmeɪnli. ɪt lʊks ˌʌndɚˈdʌn/
dialogue.zh: 主要是蝦子。看起來沒熟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, that's not good at all. I'm sorry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊ ðæts ˈnɑt ɡʊd ət ˈɔl aɪm ˈsɑɹi/
dialogue.zh: 噢，這可真不好。很抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, it's fine, these things happen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊ ɪts ˈfaɪn ðiːz θɪŋz ˈhæpən/
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，偶爾難免嘛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me take this to the chef right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi teɪk ðɪs tə ðə ˈʃɛf ˈɹaɪt ˈnaʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我馬上把這盤拿給師傅看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you. Also, the rice tasted fridge-cold.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθæŋk ju ˈɔlsoʊ ðə ˈɹaɪs ˈteɪstɪd ˈfɹɪdʒˈkoʊld/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。還有，米飯吃起來冰涼的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The rice too? That's a second problem.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈɹaɪs tuː ðæts ə ˈsɛkənd ˈpɹɑbləm/
dialogue.zh: 米飯也是？那就是第二個問題了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I don't mind waiting, but I had to say.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ doʊnt maɪnd ˈweɪtɪŋ bʌt aɪ həd tə seɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我不介意等，但一定要說出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course. Would you like a fresh roll?
dialogue.phonetic: /əv ˈkɔɹs wʊd ju laɪk ə fɹɛʃ ˈɹoʊl/
dialogue.zh: 當然。想換一盤全新的卷嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, please, fully cooked this time.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs pliz ˈfʊli kʊd ðɪs ˈtaɪm/
dialogue.zh: 好，請這一次徹底炸熟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe ten minutes. Will that work?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi tɛn ˈmɪnɪts wɪl ðæt wɜrk/
dialogue.zh: 大約十分鐘。可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's perfect, I'm not in a hurry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ˈpɜrfɪkt aɪm ˈnɑt ɪn ə ˈhɜri/
dialogue.zh: 非常好，我不趕時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great. Anything else while you wait?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt ˈɛniˌθɪŋ ɛls waɪl ju weɪt/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。等餐時還需要什麼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, miso soup, the hot kind please.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈmizoʊ ˈsup ðə hɑt kaɪnd pliz/
dialogue.zh: 好，請來碗熱騰騰的味增湯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Coming right up. Anything to drink?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkʌmɪŋ ˈɹaɪt ʌp ˈɛniˌθɪŋ tə drɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 馬上來。要喝點什麼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, hot green tea, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm hɑt ɡɹin ti pliz/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，來杯熱綠茶，謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure. The full pot or one cup?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr ðə fʊl ˈpɑt ɔr wʌn kʌp/
dialogue.zh: 好的。要一壺還是一杯？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One cup is enough, thank you.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn kʌp ɪz ɪˈnʌf ˈθæŋk ju/
dialogue.zh: 一杯就夠了，謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now, about this roll on your bill…
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ, əˈbaʊt ðɪs ˈɹoʊl ɑn jɔɹ bɪl/
dialogue.zh: 關於這盤做錯的卷……

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will that come off the check, please?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ðæt kʌm ɔf ðə tʃɛk pliz/
dialogue.zh: 會從帳單裡扣掉嗎？麻煩了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's free, the chef sent warm soup too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈfɹi ðə ʃɛf sɛnt wɔrm ˈsup tu/
dialogue.zh: 那盤免費，師傅還附了熱湯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, that's very kind of everyone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊ ðæts ˈvɛɹi kaɪnd əv ˈɛvɹiˌwʌn/
dialogue.zh: 噢，大家都太貼心了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He says the fryer ran cold today.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi ˈsɛz ðə ˈfɹaɪɚ ɹæn koʊld təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 他說今天油炸爐的溫度偏低。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! That explains the doughy batter.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ðæt ɪkˈspleɪnz ðə ˈdoʊi ˈbætɚ/
dialogue.zh: 哈！難怪麵糊濕濕的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It happens on busy nights, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈhæpənz ɑn ˈbɪzi ˈnaɪts ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 生意好的夜晚難免會這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I hear you. I used to work in a diner.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hiɾ ju aɪ ˈjʊst tə wɜrk ɪn ə daɪˈnɚ/
dialogue.zh: 我懂。我以前在餐館工作過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No way! What was your job there?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ weɪ wʌt wəz jɔɹ dʒɑb ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 真的假的！你當時做什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I served coffee, all night, for years.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ sɜrvd ˈkɔfi ɔl naɪt fɔr jɪrz/
dialogue.zh: 我端咖啡，通宵班，幹了好幾年。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's hard work. Did you like it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ˈhɑrd wɜrk dɪd ju laɪk ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那可是苦活。您喜歡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Some nights yes, especially with good tips.
dialogue.phonetic: /sʌm ˈnaɪts jɛs əˌspɛʃli wɪθ ɡʊd tɪps/
dialogue.zh: 有些晚上挺喜歡，尤其小費不錯時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! I feel you on that one.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ aɪ fil ju ɑn ðæt wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 哈！這點我超有同感。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So tonight I'll tip well, don't worry.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ təˈnaɪt aɪl tɪp wɛl doʊnt ˈwɜri/
dialogue.zh: 所以今晚我會給足小費，別擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You really don't have to, but thanks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ˈɹɪli doʊnt hæv tə bʌt ˈθæŋks/
dialogue.zh: 真的不用，但還是謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Quick question, is the salmon fresh?
dialogue.phonetic: /kwɪk ˈkwɛstʃən ɪz ðə ˈsæməm fɹɛʃ/
dialogue.zh: 快速一問，鮭魚新鮮嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it came in this very morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪt keɪm ɪn ðɪs ˈvɛɹi ˈmɔɹnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 是的，就是今天一大早送來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice. My husband loves your salmon.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs maɪ ˈhʌzbænd lʌvz jɔɹ ˈsæməm/
dialogue.zh: 不錯。我先生最愛你們的鮭魚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then next time, try the salmon roll.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ˈnɛkst ˈtaɪm traɪ ðə ˈsæməm ˈɹoʊl/
dialogue.zh: 那下次試試鮭魚卷吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We'll be back Saturday, around seven.
dialogue.phonetic: /wil bi bæk ˈsætɚˌdeɪ əˈɹaʊnd ˈsɛvən/
dialogue.zh: 我們週六會再來，七點左右。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Should I ask them to keep a table?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ ˈæsk ðəm tə kiːp ə ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 要我請他們留個位子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes please, the quiet one by the window.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs pliz ðə ˈkwaɪət wʌn baɪ ðə ˈwɪndoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 好，靠窗安靜的那個位子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done. Tea first, then your fresh roll.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdʌn ti fɜrst ðɛn jɔɹ fɹɛʃ ˈɹoʊl/
dialogue.zh: 說定了。先上茶，再上新卷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for handling this so gently.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks fɔr ˈhændəlɪŋ ðɪs soʊ ˈdʒɛntlɪ/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你這麼溫和地處理。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's our job, and honestly our pleasure.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ɑɹ dʒɑb ænd ˈɑnəstli ɑɹ ˈplɛʒɚ/
dialogue.zh: 這是我們的工作，也是榮幸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, here it comes — hot and crispy!
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊ hɪr ɪt kʌmz hɑt ænd ˈkɹɪspi/
dialogue.zh: 噢，端來了——又熱又酥脆！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The chef walked it out himself, see?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ʃɛf ˈwɔkt ɪt aʊt hɪmˈsɛlf ˈsi/
dialogue.zh: 師傅親自端出來的，看到了吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's sweet. How's everything here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ˈswit haʊz ˈɛvɹiˌθɪŋ hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 真貼心。店裡一切都好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Busy but good, we hired a new helper.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɪzi bʌt ɡʊd wi ˈhaɪərd ə nu ˈhɛlpɚ/
dialogue.zh: 很忙但不錯，我們請了新夥伴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She seems lovely, she smiled at me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi simz ˈlʌvli ʃi smaɪld ət mi/
dialogue.zh: 她看起來很親切，還對我笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She is, though she's still learning names.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi ɪz ðoʊ ʃiz stɪl ˈlɜrnɪŋ ˈneɪmz/
dialogue.zh: 是啊，不過她還在記大家的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! Give her time, we all started there.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ɡɪv hɚ ˈtaɪm wi ɔl ˈstɑrtɪd ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 哈！多給她點時間，我們都是這樣過來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: True. Enjoy your dinner, I'll refill tea.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɹu ɛnˈdʒɔɪ jɔɹ ˈdɪnɚ aɪl ˌrifɪl ˈti/
dialogue.zh: 說得是。請慢用，我來添茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you. And the soup was delicious.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθæŋk ju ænd ðə ˈsup wəz dɪˈlɪʃəs/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。那碗湯也很好喝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll tell the kitchen, they'll beam.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl tɛl ðə ˈkɪtʃɪn ðeɪl bim/
dialogue.zh: 我會轉告廚房，他們會樂開花。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please do. Have a lovely evening.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpliz du hæv ə ˈlʌvli ˈivnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 麻煩你了。祝你有個愉快的夜晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You too! Enjoy every warm bite now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju tu ɛnˈdʒɔɪ ˈɛvri wɔrm ˈbaɪt ˈnaʊ/
dialogue.zh: 您也是！好好享受每一口熱騰騰的美味。

script.youtube_title_en: "The roll is cold inside" - Sending Back Undercooked Sushi Politely
script.youtube_description:
在壽司店發現蝦卷沒熟、米飯偏冷，該怎麼有禮地請店裡換一盤？這集60句沉浸式英文聽力，帶你走一遍完整的餐廳反映流程。

劇情簡單又實用：銀髮客人咬下蝦天婦羅卷，發現中間還是冷的。她客氣地請來服務生，換到一盤現做熱卷，還收到師傅附贈的味增湯。兩人也聊起小費、留座位與新來的夥伴，最後溫馨道別。整集都是十分詞以內的短句，A2初學也能輕鬆聽懂。

你將學會：
- 用 Excuse me 溫和叫住服務生
- 用 The roll is cold inside 描述餐點問題
- 請店家留座位、講小費與道別的常用句

每句都附國際音標與繁中翻譯，後半段逐句跟讀，聽完就能開口用。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
記得訂閱頻道、開啟小鈴鐺，每天一集沉浸式英文！
script.youtube_description_en:
How do you politely send back undercooked sushi? In this 60-line immersive English listening lesson, a calm diner tells a young server that the roll is cold inside, and the whole fix unfolds from kitchen apology to warm soup, free food, and a friendly goodbye.

You will learn to:
- Call a server over with Excuse me, kindly
- Say the shrimp looks underdone and the rice is fridge-cold
- Talk about tips, a table booking, and the chef's free gift

Every line is short and clear for A2 learners, with IPA and translations, plus a line-by-line repeat section.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new immersive listening quest every week!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🍣退回壽司｜說清飯冷蝦沒熟・師傅換新卷・熱湯賠禮｜聽完就敢開口反映｜🌱A2初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
壽司咬下去中間竟是冷的，你敢請服務生換一盤嗎？怎麼說才不失禮？
這一集帶大家走進壽司店，看一位沉穩的銀髮客人，如何用溫和英文把沒熟的蝦卷換成新出鍋的熱卷。
你會聽到：
- 🍣 「The roll is cold inside.」— 一句話說清楚餐點哪裡不對。
- 🙋 「Let me take this to the chef right now.」— 服務生即時的回應。
- 🍵 「It's free, the chef sent warm soup too.」— 招待與道歉的地道說法。
- 🪑 「Should I ask them to keep a table?」— 請店家留位子的問法。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習 🎧，每句十詞以內，慢速清楚。
🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背，多聽就會用。
好好吃飯，大膽開口，我們下一集餐桌見！
